snippet.title: Slime Rancher 2 - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Follow Beatrix down the deepest passages of the Grey Labyrinth in search of the power that threatens Rainbow Island, and the whole of the Far, Far Range. Tread carefully, Ranchers. Danger awaits you in Slime Rancher 2's thrilling finale. 

A Hero in Time (v1.0) available now on Steam, Epic, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S.

Read the full Patch Notes here: https://www.slimerancher.com/news/slime-rancher-2-a-hero-in-time-patch-1-0-0-notes 

Physical pre-orders for PS5 and Xbox Series X/S are available at http://bit.ly/iam8bit-sr2 and participating retailers.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1657630/Slime_Rancher_2/
Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/slime-rancher-2
Xbox Series X/S: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/slime-rancher-2/9phfj0n31nv1
PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009803
